summary: No relevant testing skill found. ui_bugs.issue: After clicking data-testid='view-community-activity-btn', the app navigates to /referrals/live-feed but data-testid='rewarded-interstitial-watch-btn' never appears; '+5 bonus PRC' modal is not visible.

integration_issues.flow: ReferralsEnhanced openLiveFeed sessionStorage handoff to DownlineLiveFeed rewarded modal
integration_issues.issue: Instrumented sessionStorage showed pending_rewarded_ad is set on /referrals and removed on /referrals/live-feed, but the modal still does not render. Explicitly pre-seeding pending_rewarded_ad before direct /referrals/live-feed also removed the flag without opening the modal.

action_items: Make DownlineLiveFeed's pending_rewarded_ad effect StrictMode/development-safe. Do not remove the sessionStorage flag before the delayed rewardedAd.open() can survive the effect cleanup; remove it after the modal is actually opened, or open synchronously and then clear safely.

Retest the full CTA flow including No thanks dismissal, Watch & Earn web toast, and reload no-refire after the modal is visible. These positive modal actions could not be completed because the modal never appeared.
critical_code_review_comments: Likely RCA: React StrictMode in preview double-invokes effects. DownlineLiveFeed useEffect reads and removes pending_rewarded_ad, schedules a 350ms timer, then StrictMode cleanup clears that timer before it fires; the second effect run sees the flag already removed and returns, so rewardedAd.open() never runs.

ReferralsEnhanced correctly sets pending_rewarded_ad before navigate(), and CommunityDashboard CTA is wired to onOpenLiveFeed. The failure is on the destination effect lifecycle/timer/flag clearing behavior.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Review-request credential 9696969696/969696 was not usable in preview, so the primary user from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (9970100782/997010) was used to verify the same referrals CTA flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Skill lookup returned no relevant testing skill. Browser evidence: direct /referrals/live-feed with no flag produced modal_count=0 (pass). Main CTA flow produced sessionStorage ops set on /referrals and remove on /referrals/live-feed, URL changed to /referrals/live-feed, but modal_count=0 and '+5 bonus PRC' text absent. Explicit pre-seeded flag on /referrals/live-feed also resulted in flag_after=null and modal_count=0.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: login, go to /referrals, click data-testid='view-community-activity-btn'. Expected rewarded interstitial +5 PRC opt-in modal on /referrals/live-feed. Actual: destination page loads with live feed content but no rewarded modal. Probable mitigation: move sessionStorage removal into the timer after rewardedAd.open(), or otherwise guard the effect so React StrictMode cleanup cannot consume the flag and cancel the only timer.
